workouts.summary: This week we tighten up both hands on the spot, then add retreat dribbles and combo counters on the move.

drills.name: Wrap & Snap Series
drills.summary: Quick hands around the body, then snap back into a hard dribble.
steps: Wrap the ball around your waist 5 times each way.
Go straight into 10 hard dribbles with your right hand.
Wrap again, then 10 hard dribbles with your left hand.
Keep your eyes on a spot ahead the whole time.
Repeat until the timer ends.

drills.name: Retreat & Re-Attack
drills.summary: Back out of pressure, then attack the open side.
steps: Attack forward 3 hard dribbles with your right hand.
Pull back 2 retreat dribbles and keep the ball on your hip.
Cross over to your left hand and attack forward again.
Repeat going the other way, starting with your left hand.
Stay low the whole time and keep your chest up.

drills.name: Combo Counter Series
drills.summary: Chain two moves together, then counter with a third.
steps: Start at the top of the driveway with the ball in your right hand.
Do a crossover into a between-the-legs dribble.
Counter with a behind-the-back, then attack 2 dribbles.
Walk back and start with your left hand.
Speed up each round, but not past what you can control.

workouts.summary: This week's film looks at spacing, transition pushes and how defenses rotate to help.

drills.name: Film: Spacing & Driving Lanes
drills.equipment: Game film on a phone or laptop
drills.summary: See how good spacing opens driving lanes for the ball handler.
steps: Watch 10 minutes of game film and watch spacing on offense.
Watch where the four players without the ball stand.
Pause when a player drives and say if the lane was open or crowded.
Say which player could move to open it up.
Write one or two takeaways in your notebook.

drills.name: Film: Transition Push
drills.equipment: Game film on a phone or laptop
drills.summary: Learn when to push the ball and when to pull it out.
steps: Watch 10 minutes of game film and watch transition offense.
After every defensive rebound, watch the point guard's first look.
Pause when they cross half court and say: push or pull it out?
Say if there was an advantage, like 2-on-1 or 3-on-2.
Write one or two takeaways in your notebook.

drills.name: Film: Help-Side Rotations
drills.equipment: Game film on a phone or laptop
drills.summary: Read how the defense rotates so you can find the open player.
steps: Watch 10 minutes of game film and watch defensive rotations.
When the ball gets in the paint, watch who helps.
Pause and say which offensive player is now open.
Check if the passer found that player.
Write one or two takeaways in your notebook.

workouts.summary: This week we finish with the inside hand, add reverses and floaters, and attack off two dribbles.

drills.name: Inside-Hand Layups
drills.summary: Finish with the hand farthest from the defender.
steps: Start on the right wing, attack the rim with 2 dribbles.
Finish with your left hand on the right side.
Rebound, go to the left wing and finish with your right hand.
Keep the ball high and away from where a defender would be.
Alternate sides until the timer ends.

drills.name: Reverse Layup Ladder
drills.summary: Use the rim to protect the ball on reverse finishes.
steps: Start on the baseline, right side.
Drive under the rim and finish on the other side with your left hand.
Rebound, start on the left baseline.
Finish on the other side with your right hand.
Speed up each round.

drills.name: Two-Dribble Attack
drills.summary: Get from the three-point line to the rim in two dribbles.
steps: Start at the top of the key, facing the rim.
Jab, then attack with a long first step.
Get to the rim in only 2 dribbles and finish.
Rebound, go back out and attack the other direction.
Count your dribbles every rep.

drills.name: Floater Range Finish
drills.summary: Score over the big guy from just inside the paint.
steps: Start at the wing and drive hard to the middle of the paint.
Stop about 2 steps from the rim.
Float the ball high off one hand with a soft touch.
Finish off one foot, then off two feet next rep.
Switch sides and hands every 2 reps.

workouts.summary: This week we clean up the release, then shoot after moving to open spots and off a step-back.

drills.name: One-Hand Release Ladder
drills.summary: Groove a clean one-hand release, moving back one step at a time.
steps: Start 3 feet from the rim with only your shooting hand on the ball.
Make 3 shots, then take one step back.
Keep going until you are at the free throw line.
If you miss twice in a row, step back in one spot.
Hold your follow-through on every shot.

drills.name: Relocate & Fire
drills.summary: Move to an open spot after you pass, then catch and shoot ready.
steps: Start on the wing and toss the ball out to yourself, or pass to your rebounder.
Slide to the corner or up to the top.
Catch with your feet set and shoot.
Get the rebound and go to a new spot.
Track your makes out of 20.

drills.name: Step-Back Series
drills.summary: Create space off the dribble and shoot balanced.
steps: Start at the elbow facing the rim.
Attack 1 hard dribble, then step back with both feet.
Gather the ball tight and rise into your shot.
Do 5 going right, then 5 going left.
Move out to the three-point line once you feel smooth.

workouts.summary: This week we work on retreating, mirroring the ball handler and stopping the drive with good feet.

drills.name: Drop-Step Retreat
drills.summary: Turn and run with the driver without losing your stance.
steps: Start in a low stance at the top of the key.
Slide 2 times to your right.
Drop-step back with your left foot and run 3 steps.
Get back into your stance and slide again.
Switch directions every rep.

drills.name: Shadow Mirror
drills.summary: Mirror your partner's moves and stay in front.
steps: Face your partner about 3 feet apart.
Your partner moves side to side and changes speeds.
Slide to stay chest to chest with them.
No crossing your feet and no reaching.
Switch roles every 30 seconds.

drills.name: Contain the Drive
drills.summary: Beat the driver to the spot and keep them out of the paint.
steps: Your partner starts at the wing with the ball.
They attack at 75% speed toward the rim.
Slide and beat them to the spot with your feet.
Keep your hands back and stay out of their body.
Switch roles every 3 drives.

workouts.summary: This week we build game-speed conditioning with dribble sprints, defensive shuffles and a full-court push.

drills.name: Dribble Sprint Intervals
drills.summary: Sprint with the ball at game speed, then recover.
steps: Start on the baseline with a ball.
Speed dribble to half court in 4 seconds or less.
Walk back to the baseline.
Use your right hand going up, your left hand next rep.
Keep going until the timer ends.

drills.name: Slide Shuttle
drills.summary: Defensive slides at game speed between two cones.
steps: Put 2 cones about 15 feet apart.
Slide from one cone to the other and touch it.
Slide back and touch the first cone.
Go hard for 20 seconds, then rest for 10 seconds.
Keep your stance low the whole time.

drills.name: Cone Sprint Ladder
drills.summary: Sprint to cones that get farther away each time.
steps: Set cones at the free throw line, half court, far free throw line and far baseline.
Sprint to the first cone and back.
Sprint to the second cone and back.
Keep going until you reach the far baseline.
Rest 20 seconds, then repeat.

drills.name: Four-Corner Push
drills.summary: Dribble around the full court at game speed and finish at both ends.
steps: Put a cone in each corner of the court.
Speed dribble around the outside, cone to cone.
Each time you pass a hoop, cut in and finish a layup.
Go 45 seconds hard, then rest 15 seconds.
Change direction every round.
